sn34.35-40:1.1: samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī ca ayam imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ || || Vitthāretabbaṃ || || Sāvatthi || || Samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo || || Samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo || || Neva samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo || || Samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo ca || || Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī || pa || uttamo ca pavaro cā ti || || Cattāro me bhikkhave jhāyī || || katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo || pe || Samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || pe || || Samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ
